headline: NBU, EBRD, and Korn Ferry present self-assessment model for financial institutions working with veterans
summary: The National Bank of Ukraine, the EBRD and Korn Ferry presented a scoring model for financial institutions to assess readiness to work with veterans. It was presented to signatories of the Charter on Financial Inclusion and Reintegration of Veterans.
why: The National Bank of Ukraine is the country's central bank and regulator for its banking sector. The EBRD is a multilateral lender that finances private-sector development in Ukraine.
